title: Real drawer slides in the model
notes: Side-mount drawer slides are now drawn with your slide model (closed and open) instead of plain boxes: against the cabinet side, front flush with the…
Opening a drawer shows the open slide model; closing it shows the closed one again. The state is kept through edits and rebuilds.
New modules and the built-in presets now use side-mount full-extension slides by default (modules and presets you saved keep their drawer system).
Existing modules: select them and Rebuild (right-click) to get the slide models. The Configurator preview still shows simple slides.

Al abrir una gaveta se ve la corredera abierta; al cerrarla, la cerrada. El estado se mantiene al editar y reconstruir.
